svg.title: A continuum of Recursive Emergence
svg.desc: Nine concentric rings, one per layer from cosmos to the synthetic layer, each labelled with thinkers; the synthetic ring is marked not yet. Every ring has a gap, a door to the next. The doors of the cosmos, matter and chemistry rings are found by search; from life outward each door is a residue, something the layer can state about itself but not settle from inside. A solid thread of recursion starts at a central dot and extends outward through every door, past a dashed edge into an open haze: whatever comes next. A dashed thread of reflection runs back inward from the cultural layer, labelled Gödel to Einstein, 1949, and stops just short of the centre.

textPath.tspan: what no layer can settle from inside
